The chart machine came apart on 2026-08-13: its 40 files went to skills/chart, seven builder machines under cairn/devices/builder/machines, cairn/tools/chain, cairn/tools/tree and skills/moreabout — no plurality, which is why the derivation correctly answers nothing and a hand must. skills/chart is the successor because the component's CHARTER moved there whole and now covers the skill AND the chain it calls: 'There is no separate device charter: the chart machine dissolved on 2026-08-13 and its charter moved here whole.'
